ops.text: 11.3 Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, without penalty or early termination charge, in which case Commerce One shall refund to Corio any prepaid fees allocable to the period after the effective date of such termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial five (5) year term or any renewal term.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement runs an initial five (5) year term but gives us no exit other than for breach or insolvency, so we have added a convenience termination right on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees, consistent with our playbook position. If a longer runway is needed we can move to 60-90 days' notice.
input.summary: Add Corio right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; no Commerce One convenience right mid-term.
